answer.instructions: Does the source text support the claim?

criteria.true: The source text states or clearly implies the claim
criteria.false: The source text contradicts the claim or does not back it up

state.claim: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
state.source: The Eiffel Tower, built for the 1889 World's Fair in Paris, opened to the public in May 1889 after about two years of construction.

state.claim: The Eiffel Tower is the tallest structure in France.
state.source: The Eiffel Tower is 330 metres tall. The Millau Viaduct in southern France has a mast that reaches 343 metres, making it the tallest structure in the country.

state.claim: Honey never spoils when stored in a sealed container.
state.source: Archaeologists have found pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that were still edible. Honey's low water content and acidity keep bacteria from growing.

state.claim: Humans use only 10 percent of their brains.
state.source: Brain imaging shows activity across virtually all regions of the brain over the course of a day. Even during sleep, many areas stay active.
Mount Kilimanjaro, a dormant volcano, rises 5,895 metres above sea level in north-eastern Tanzania, near the border with Kenya.

state.claim: Venus is the hottest planet in the solar system.
state.source: Venus has a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere that traps heat, giving it a surface temperature of about 465 degrees Celsius, hotter than Mercury even though Mercury is closer to the Sun.

state.claim: Vitamin C prevents the common cold.
state.source: A review of 29 trials found that taking vitamin C regularly did not reduce how many colds people caught, though it slightly shortened colds in some groups.

state.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
state.source: Astronauts have reported that the Great Wall is very hard to see from low Earth orbit without aid. It is long but only a few metres wide, and it blends into the landscape.

state.claim: The first iPhone was released in 2007.
state.source: Apple announced the iPhone in January 2007 and it went on sale in the United States on 29 June 2007.
A shark's skeleton is made of cartilage, the same flexible tissue found in the human nose and ears, rather than of bone.

state.claim: Coffee is the most traded commodity in the world after oil.
state.source: Coffee is one of the most widely traded agricultural products, and Brazil, Vietnam and Colombia are its largest exporters. Wheat and soybeans are traded in larger volumes.

state.claim: Water boils at a lower temperature at high altitude.
state.source: Atmospheric pressure drops as altitude rises, so water boils at about 95 degrees Celsius at 2,000 metres instead of 100 degrees at sea level.
